en.headline: Major banks hold Hong Kong prime rates after HKMA base-rate rise
en.dek: HSBC, Bank of China (Hong Kong) and Standard Chartered left their best lending rates unchanged on Thursday despite the monetary authority lifting the Base Rate to 4.25 per cent.
body: Leading Hong Kong banks announced on Thursday that they would keep their Hong Kong dollar prime rates unchanged after the Hong Kong Monetary Authority raised the Base Rate by a quarter point to 4.25 per cent.

HSBC said its best lending rate remained at 5 per cent. Bank of China (Hong Kong) also held its prime rate at 5 per cent and its savings deposit rate at 0.001 per cent. Standard Chartered Hong Kong left its prime lending rate at 5.25 per cent.

The HKMA move followed the US Federal Reserve’s 25-basis-point increase in the federal funds target range. Under the linked exchange rate formula the Base Rate is set at the higher of 50 basis points above the lower end of the US target range or a moving average of short-term HIBOR rates.

HSBC separately said it would raise the interest rate on its US dollar savings accounts by 12.4 basis points to 0.125 per cent from 18 September. Local analysts noted that banks often lag Base Rate changes when interbank funding costs remain relatively soft.

zh.headline: 主要銀行維持港元最優惠利率不變
zh.dek: 金管局將基本利率上調至4.25厘後，匯豐、中銀香港及渣打均宣布維持港元最優惠利率不變。
body: 香港主要銀行周四宣布，在金管局將基本利率上調四分一厘至4.25厘後，仍維持港元最優惠利率不變。
匯豐表示港元最優惠利率維持5厘；中銀香港亦維持最優惠利率5厘及儲蓄存款利率0.001厘；渣打香港則維持最優惠貸款利率5.25厘。
金管局是次調整跟隨美國聯儲局加息25基點。根據聯繫匯率預設公式，基本利率取美國聯邦基金利率目標區間下限加50基點，或隔夜及一個月香港銀行同業拆息五天移動平均數的平均值，兩者以較高者為準。
匯豐另宣布由9月18日起上調美元儲蓄存款利率12.4基點至年利率0.125%。分析指，銀行同業拆息仍然相對平穩時，銀行未必即時跟隨基本利率調整最優惠利率。
